summary: Seeking endorsement of various events for liquor licensing purposes.
decided: City Council on June 26, 27, 28 and 29, 2018, adopted the following: 1. City Council advise the Alcohol and Gaming Commission of Ontario that it has no objection, for liquor licensing purposes, to the following requests noting that the applicants are required to comply with other applicable by-laws and to obtain the necessary permits for any patio areas extending into the City's right of way: a. Temporary liquor license extensions for patios at the following establishments taking part in the Bloor West Street Fest, being held in the Bloor West Village Business Improvement Area, from 10:00 a.m. to 10:00 p.m. on July 14, 2018: - Shakey's at 2255 Bloor Street West - Ka Chi at 2322 Bloor Street West b. The Annual Taste of the Kingsway Festival: 1. to be held on Bloor Street West, from Prince Edward Drive to Montgomery Road, on: - September 7, 2018 from 6:00 p.m. to 10:00 p.m. - September 8, 2018 from 11:00 a.m. to 10:00 p.m. - September 9, 2018 from 11:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. 2. to operate a Beer Garden at Montgomery Road, Humbervale Boulevard and Prince Edward Drive; and 3. for temporary liquor license extensions for patios at various businesses, as listed in the letter (May 15, 2018) from the Chair, Kingsway Business Improvement Area, during the Taste of the Kingsway Festival. c. A temporary liquor licence extension for an extended patio at the Churrasqueira Martin's Grill House…
